name: The White Mountains
summary: New Hampshire's alpine heart — the Northeast's tallest peak, a byway made for leaf season, and glacier-carved notches.

lodging.name: Omni Mount Washington Resort, Bretton Woods
lodging.blurb: A grand 1902 hotel beneath Mount Washington — the definitive White Mountains stay.

foodMustTry.name: Maple everything
foodMustTry.blurb: Roadside sugar houses sell syrup, candy, and maple soft-serve — peak New England.

days.label: Day 39 — Mount Washington
days.summary: Ride the world's first mountain-climbing cog railway to the roof of the Northeast.

item.title: Mount Washington Cog Railway

location.name: Mount Washington Cog Railway
location.address: 3168 Base Station Rd, Mount Washington, NH

item.blurb: Since 1869, a steam-and-coal cog train up the steepest tracks in the country to a 6,288-ft summit famous for some of the worst weather on earth.
gear: warm layers (the summit is frigid and windswept)

days.label: Day 40 — Kancamagus & Franconia Notch
days.summary: The most beautiful drive in New England during foliage.

item.title: Drive the Kancamagus Highway
item.blurb: A 34-mile National Scenic Byway with no gas or services and endless overlooks, waterfalls, and, in October, walls of color.

item.title: Flume Gorge, Franconia Notch
item.blurb: A boardwalk trail through a mossy granite gorge with waterfalls and covered bridges.

days.label: Day 41 — Cannon & the Notch
days.summary: Ride above the notch and explore the caves.

item.title: Cannon Mountain Aerial Tramway
item.blurb: An 80-second ride to a 4,080-ft summit with views across the Presidentials.

item.title: The New England Ski Museum
item.blurb: It sits at the foot of the tramway you just rode, and it is free. A hundred and fifty years of the sport in one room — hickory skis and leather boots, the 10th Mountain Division troops who trained on these slopes and came home to build the American ski industry, and Bode Miller's medals, from Franconia, three miles down the road.

item.title: Lost River Gorge & Boulder Caves

location.name: Lost River Gorge
location.address: 1712 Lost River Rd, North Woodstock, NH

item.blurb: Boardwalks and ladders through a boulder-choked gorge and squeeze-through caves.

days.label: Day 42 — Free Day
days.summary: Slow morning, a covered-bridge drive, or an easy hike. Optional ideas below.

freeMenu.title: Conway Scenic Railroad
freeMenu.blurb: A vintage train through Crawford Notch in prime foliage.

freeMenu.title: Diana's Baths
freeMenu.blurb: An easy walk to a staircase of small waterfalls and pools.

days.label: Day 43 — South to the capital
days.summary: Down out of the mountains to Concord.

commute.scenicNote: South through the lakes region toward New Hampshire's capital.
